description: Upload bytes to Google Drive from a blob (blob_key). Content comes from platform blob storage only — to upload a local file, ingest it via blob_storage_service.store_blob_from_file first and pass the resulting blob_key. Optional parent folder id and mime type override. Runs as a background job: dispatch returns a job_id immediately, and the new file's id and web view link arrive via a follow-up message once the upload completes. Requires a connected account.
embedding_description: Upload bytes from platform blob storage into Google Drive as a new binary file, as a background job. Requires a display name and optional parent folder or MIME override; dispatch returns a job_id for tracking, and completion delivers the created Drive file id and web link. Use this write path to place a platform-held blob in Drive after local files have been ingested into blob storage.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Job queued for the Drive upload; completion will be delivered automatically.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Return exactly one action using the active IO plugin's post_message (process_key: plugin::<io_plugin>::post_message). Use the provided session_id. Keep the message short and friendly. Do NOT invent process identifiers (no present_result, no status actions).

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Dispatch a background job to upload a file into Google Drive from a blob.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.invalid_params: blob_key not supplied, or missing session_id/flow_id context. gsuite.not_found: the referenced blob_key does not exist. gsuite.not_connected: no account linked. gsuite.api_error: AsyncJobManager unavailable or job creation failed.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: gsuite.invalid_params: supply a blob_key (ingest a local file via store_blob_from_file first if needed). gsuite.not_connected: run connect_account. gsuite.api_error: retry once platform startup has completed.
